about: How the broker, the one process of a benchmark run that holds the API key, is started (benchmark/harness/broker.ts; docs/design-review.md, untrusted-test-isolation): under exactly this version of Node, whose permission model these flags rely on, with an environment cleared but for PATH (env -i, since NODE_OPTIONS could add --allow-child-process), and with exactly these flags, $GITHUB_WORKSPACE standing for the workspace. The workflow policy (.github/scripts/policy.test.mjs) requires each secret job's broker step to start it so, and every job that runs the harness's tests to run them on this version of Node; the harness's test runs planted escapes under these flags. None of refused may appear among them: each would let the process start another, run a worker, an addon or WASI, write a file, or open an inspector.
